title: Carson Teva
subtitle: New Republic
description: Carson Teva was a prominent pilot in the New Republic. Teva first encountered The Mandalorian Din Djarin when the latter was stopped and questioned about his role in the events that recently transpired at a New Republic prison ship. Since the first meeting, Carson came to understand Mando's role in the galaxy better, and even became involved in the safety of the independent planet Nevarro.
